description: Fit-critical artwork whose surviving strokes are all 0.8 mm, but the opening removed 40 % of its area, so the label no longer reads as drawn: blocker.

findings.fix: fit-critical artwork, such as a label someone reads to calibrate, must print as drawn: make its strokes wider than 0.8 mm (a bolder weight or a larger size) until the opening removes at most 1 %
findings.message: the morphological opening removed 40.0 % of the fit-critical artwork area, more than the 1 % allowed (maxRemovedAreaPct of process `fdm-0.4`): strokes thinner than the 0.8 mm minimum feature do not print, and the removed regions are shown in red in the preview
